ideas.title: A snowball that grows as it rolls
ideas.goal: After a night of snow the player, as Lumi, pushes a snowball across the meadow; it packs on the snow it rolls over, gets heavier and harder to push uphill, and they lift one onto another to build a snow friend that stands or topples by how well they centred it. Fun: a toy you get better at (deep snow packs faster, slopes run away with it, a lopsided ball rolls crooked), and the bare grass trail shows where you went.
ideas.idea: Snow is a depth field over the island laid by a real snowfall (physics/snow.jl: snow lands on the topmost surface, sheltered under roofs and trees, slides off at its angle of repose). The ball is a real rigid body (PrintSim affine body on Mantle) rolling on that field: the snow under it compacts by Bekker's pressure-sinkage law with published snow parameters, which gives the rolling resistance, and the compacted layer sticks to the ball, so radius, mass AND inertia grow from the snow actually removed (mass conserved, the grass shows through). Pushing is a force from Lumi's body, not a speed. Stacking: Lumi lifts a ball (only if it is light enough for Lumi's strength) and sets it down; IPC contact and friction decide whether the top ball sits or rolls off. Watching: a ball getting fat and wobbly, a dark grass track, a head that slides off a body.
ideas.form: A plugin (snow field and terramechanics kernel on the GPU, the balls as PrintSim bodies) with push and lift keys in Jump in; a traced morning film of one ball growing down a slope and a head set on it.

ideas.title: Sandcastle against the tide
ideas.goal: The player builds a sandcastle on the beach with a bucket and their hands, then the tide comes in and eats it; the one that lasts longest wins. Fun: damp sand stands in walls that dry sand never could and soaked sand flows, so learning how wet to make it and how to pack it is the skill.
ideas.idea: Sand as an MPM continuum on Mantle, built from Maelstrom's particle-grid transfers: Drucker-Prager elastoplasticity (Klar et al. 2016, the standard for sand) with a cohesion that depends on each particle's water saturation (capillary bridges: zero dry, peak when damp, gone when soaked, as in Tampubolon et al. 2017). The bucket packs particles; the tide is Maelstrom water rising on a clock that saturates the foot of the walls and drags at them. Watching: towers stand, the first wave licks the foot, a wall leans and slumps into a wet fan.
ideas.form: A beach plugin (bucket, pat and wet keys, the tide on the island's clock) in a small MPM box at the waterline; a traced film of one castle from the last pat to its collapse.

ideas.title: Steer a hot-air balloon by the winds
ideas.goal: The player flies Lumi in a little hot-air balloon: the only controls are the burner (up) and the vent (down), and the wind blows a different way at every height, so to get anywhere they must find the layer that goes their way, and the game is to drop a letter on a friend's roof. Fun: a calm, readable skill (watch the smoke, climb, catch the wind) and a landing that is never quite where you meant.
ideas.idea: Buoyancy from the real air density of the envelope (ideal gas at its temperature), heated by the burner, cooling through the fabric by Newton's law, so the balloon answers late, the way real ones do; drag on envelope and basket; wind as layers with shear that turn with height (the island's wind field given a vertical profile, shown by the chimney smoke and floating seeds). The envelope is a pressurised PrintSim cloth that sags when cool. Watching: Lumi's basket drifting over the island, rising into a different wind and turning.
ideas.form: A new flying mode in Jump in plus a balloon asset; a traced film of a flight that changes direction twice and drops the letter.

ideas.title: Fell a tree to bridge the stream
ideas.goal: The player saws a dead tree by the stream: where they cut the notch and how deep they saw decide which way it falls, and if they aim it right it lands across the water as a bridge the friends then walk over. Fun: a real decision with a big, loud payoff, and a miss (it falls into the pond, or onto the shed) is a story too.
ideas.idea: The trunk is a beam whose hinge (the wood left between the notch and the back cut) holds it like real felling: the hinge's bending strength shrinks as Lumi saws, the tree leans under its own weight and the hinge's width steers it, then it breaks and the trunk falls as a PrintSim body, bounces on its branches and comes to rest. A log that lands across both banks becomes walkable, and its sag under a friend is its FEM bending (physics/modes.jl's beam check).
ideas.form: A plugin with a dead tree asset by the stream, saw and notch keys in Jump in; a traced film of the fall and the first friend crossing.

ideas.title: Burn a picture with a magnifying glass
ideas.goal: On a sunny day the player holds a lens over a plank and draws by burning: the smaller and brighter the spot, the faster the wood browns and smokes, so steadiness and the right height are the skill, and the finished board hangs in the friends' gallery. A dry leaf pile catches if they are careless. Fun: drawing with the sun, a real thing you make and keep.
ideas.idea: The spot is real: sun rays traced through the lens mesh on the GPU (Raycore, refraction by Snell's law) and gathered on the plank, so the focus, the caustic ring when it is too high and clouds dimming it come from optics, not a decal. The plank's surface heats by that irradiance (a 2D heat equation with conduction and cooling) and chars where it passes the charring temperature, into a texture that stays. Smoke rises from hot cells.
ideas.form: A plugin (lens held by Lumi, plank on the workbench) and the burned board as a gallery asset; a traced close film of a bright spot dragging a brown line.

ideas.title: A trebuchet from logs
ideas.goal: The player builds a trebuchet from logs, rope and a stone counterweight, then flings pumpkins at the old scarecrow across the field; changing the sling length, the release pin and the weight changes the shot. Fun: tinker, fire, miss, tinker, a hit is a cheer and a broken pumpkin.
ideas.idea: A real multibody: arm, counterweight and sling as PrintSim bodies with joints (the docs/dynamics.md joints), the sling releases when its angle passes the pin, the pumpkin flies with drag and splits on impact (the knock project's voxel pumpkin breaking along its weakest cells). Watching: the counterweight drops, the arm whips, the pumpkin arcs over the meadow.
ideas.form: A mini game at the field edge with the parts placed by Lumi; a traced slow-motion film of a release and a hit.
